title: Source dormancy + course-tag filtering for all source kinds
description:
Today workspace.rs source_visible_for_course (~L1064) only applies course tags to Textbook/Syllabus/WorkedExample. AI conversations and other kinds go into every workspace regardless of tags, so the Java conversations are in every CPSC5005 (C++) workspace.
Change:
- Apply course tags to every source kind: tagged → visible only for listed courses; untagged → visible everywhere (unchanged).
- Dormant = non-empty courses with none in active_courses. Exclude from workspaces for Session/MultiSession/Course/Topic/Resource scopes. Still allowed in explicit --source scope (maybe with a note). Still wikilinkable (the vault-stems index is unaffected) and still counted as credited.
- Derive from config at query time; never store it.
- Topic/Resource scopes currently include every non-staged source: decide whether dormant ones are excluded there too (lean yes).
- Tests: tagged AI conversation is hidden from another course's session; a dormant source is excluded from session/course scope but included in --source scope; re-activating the course brings it back.
Note: changes behaviour for tagged non-textbook sources. Mention in CHANGELOG.
